subject: Agriculture
title: Taming the Aurochs
description: A micro-lesson that makes Taming the Aurochs usable.

hook.text: Modern cattle descend from the aurochs—a wild ox that stood six feet tall and weighed a ton.

buildup.text: Aurochs were aggressive and dangerous. Ancient cave paintings depict humans hunting them with spears.

discovery.text: Cattle were independently domesticated twice—once in the Near East and once in the Indus Valley.

twist.text: The last wild aurochs died in Poland in 1627. The species that built civilization went extinct.

climax.text: Today 1 billion cattle roam the earth—descendants of a fierce beast no one could tame easily.

punchline.text: The wild ancestor is gone. Its billion descendants remain.

quiz.question: When did the last wild aurochs die?
